title: Dynamic method dispatch
answer: Dynamic method dispatch is Java's runtime selection of an overridden instance method based on the actual object's class when the call is made through a superclass or interface reference. The reference type determines what members are accessible at compile time, while the runtime type determines which eligible override executes. AeroTopo's `Product.resolutionMetres()` contract dispatches to `Orthomosaic.resolutionMetres()` or `Dem.resolutionMetres()` depending on the Product object's actual subtype.
